notes.title: Etiquette Elegance opens its doors!
notes.content: [p]Step into a world where refined etiquette collides with the unpredictable whims of guests, and every table hides new surprises. Master the art of service, deliver with grace, and experience the surreal charm of [i]Etiquette Elegance[/i].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Join today and become part of this strange and magnificent world![/b][/p]

notes.title: 🚨 Demo Closing Soon
notes.content:
[p]Thank you to everyone who played the demo and shared their feedback!
If you haven’t had a chance to try the game yet — don’t worry, the demo will remain available [b]until the end of this week[/b].[/p][p]Development is moving full steam ahead. We've carefully reviewed your feedback and have already started implementing improvements based on it.[/p][p]Thank you for your support and interest!
We can’t wait to show you the full version of the game.[/p]

notes.title: More Languages for Release!
notes.content: [p]We're happy to announce that we're expanding our language support for the full release. The game will be available in the following new languages:[/p][list][*][p]Simplified Chinese[/p][/*][*][p]Spanish (Spain)[/p][/*][*][p]Portuguese (Brazil)[/p][/*][*][p]Japanese[/p][/*][/list][p][b]⚠️ Note:[/b] These languages are [b]not available[/b] in the demo version.[/p]

notes.title: Exclusive Gameplay Showcase All Week Long!
notes.content: [p]Etiquette Elegance special show - exclusive gameplay with new levels![/p][p][/p][p]We've prepared a [b]pre-recorded gameplay showcase[/b] of the demo — featuring a full playthrough of the main levels, plus several [b]bonus levels [/b]that haven't been shown before.[/p][p][/p][p]⚠️ Please note: this video is pre-recorded.[/p][p][/p][p]Add the game to your [b]wishlist[/b] so you don't miss future updates and the release date![/p]

notes.title: The Etiquette Elegance demo is now available!
notes.content: [p]The [b]Etiquette Elegance[/b] demo is now available![/p][p][/p][p]Welcome to a retro-futuristic restaurant where grace matters more than speed, and table setting is a true art form.[/p][p]In the demo, you’ll get a taste of the essentials:[/p][list][*][p] Taking guest orders and managing your notepad[/p][/*][*][p] First challenges in setting the table[/p][/*][*][p] Basic training in proper table etiquette[/p][/*][*][p] A few levels with gradually increasing difficulty[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This is merely the appetizer. The main course awaits in the full version:[/p][list][*][p] More guest personalities with quirks and preferences[/p][/*][*][p] A wider variety of tables and layouts[/p][/*][*][p] An expanded selection of utensils and dishes[/p][/*][*][p] Events of the day that turn dinner into delightful disaster[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Are you ready to prove yourself worthy of serving in an establishment so refined, even the cockroaches look aristocratic?[/p][p][/p][p][b]Download the demo and start serving with elegance![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567267/255f492451b06e4cb1210ae6807078ee0269bb07.png"][/img][/p]
